title: Knowledge Record Retirement Policy
description: Deprecation, archive, and retirement rules for Knowledge Records. Specification only.

states.meaning: Still resolvable; replacement planned or advised; new dependents SHOULD NOT target it.
allowed_actions: Keep indexes with deprecated status flag

states.meaning: Read-only historical record; not for active compilation into new official packages.
entry_requires: Prior deprecated state (or exceptional Governance waiver)
allowed_actions: Cite historically with explicit archived status

states.meaning: Lifecycle closed. record_id remains reserved forever; content retained for audit.

hard_rules.statement: Retirement MUST NOT reuse or reassign the retired record_id.
Retirement MUST NOT silently delete academic provenance; files remain under governance retention.
Supersede REQUIRES successor_record_id and cross_reference updates.
Downstream DEPENDS_ON / FOUNDATIONAL_FOR edges SHOULD be remapped or marked before archive.
